🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk appetite drained as sticky inflation and $82 oil pushed Bitcoin under $63,000, with spot ETFs bleeding two straight days. Washington deepened the gloom — yet Wall Street and Israeli banks kept building. 📉 Bitcoin Slips Below $63K as Inflation Data Disappoints and ETFs Post First Two-Day Drawdown of August Bitcoin wiped out last week's gains and slid under $63,000 after U.S. inflation figures failed to deliver the dovish surprise traders wanted, while WTI crude topping $82 a barrel and rising bond yields squeezed risk assets broadly. Spot bitcoin ETFs recorded back-to-back outflows for the first time since late July, and altcoins found no direction of their own — XRP is now teetering around the $1 mark. Read full story 🏛️ SEC Abruptly Cancels Its Landmark "Reg Crypto" Proposal With No New Date The first major crypto rulebook to be proposed by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission was pulled at the last minute, with the agency postponing its open meeting indefinitely. The regulator had been ready to release at least part of a long-awaited "innovation exemption" for tokenization alongside it; that too is now delayed amid pushback from Wall Street and the White House. More details 🔍 Tether Completes First Full Financial Audit, Wins Clean KPMG Opinion on $180B USDT After years of promises, the world's largest stablecoin issuer says a Big Four firm has finished examining its books — with KPMG U.S. going as far as physically counting Tether's gold bars. A clean opinion on the reserves behind roughly $180 billion of USDT removes one of the longest-standing question marks hanging over the crypto market's core settlement asset. Read more 🏦 Israel's Largest Bank Partners With Galaxy to Launch Direct Crypto Trading Bank Leumi will let customers buy, hold and sell bitcoin, ether and solana inside its Leumi Trade app from early 2027, making it the first Israeli bank to offer digital assets directly. Galaxy Digital supplies the trading rails through GalaxyOne Institutional and the custody layer formerly known as GK8 — another sign that banks would rather own the customer relationship than cede it to exchanges. 77495.subject: 💀 OpenAI kills Google's new model in a day
77495.body:
The Atlas

Автор: GenAI Works


Автор: GenAI Works

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/openai-kills-googles-new-model-day-genai-works-ay3kf?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3B7F75pRzERqaZPKHzdgY0Pw%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=0NrRCfXHoLoYo1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mst3qof2~yf-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mst3qof2-yf
  
Welcome back! This edition covers ChatGPT moving onto your screen, Google cutting prices at a billion users, the actual math behind going viral on X and a wallet built for software.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: How close is too close? OpenAI shipped three things in one week: ChatGPT now watches your computer, opens your Drive files and answers 14x faster. Why is the winner cutting prices? Gemini hit 1 billion users faster than any Google product ever, then Google halved the price of its newest Flash model two days later. What is a like actually worth? X open-sourced its ranking algorithm, and the copy-link share turns out to be worth 40 likes while your reposts are worth 2. Would you give your agent $10? Cloudflare launched Wallets so agents can finally pay for APIs themselves, with spending caps that make the autonomy safe. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. ChatGPT got closer to you All three do the same thing: put less distance between you and the model. Computer History lets ChatGPT watch everything you do on your computer.  It learns how you work, picks up tasks you left half-finished and suggests automations based on your real habits.  Sam Altman told a room of interns last week that an assistant with this much context was six months away.  The first piece arrived in one. Google Drive inside ChatGPT ends the tab switching.  Docs, Sheets and Slides open in a side panel.  Rolling out on the web to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise. Ultrafast runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14x faster, at 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras and starting in the API.  Fast used to mean switching to a smaller model. Now it doesn't. That speed opens new jobs.   → OpenAI's engineers read logs and traces while an outage is still happening  → Research that ran overnight now finishes in an afternoon  → Support agents solve multi-step problems without the pause that loses the call So the assistant sees your screen, sits with your files and keeps up with your conversation. What about the security part? Computer History raises the risk of prompt injection.  Visit a website with hidden malicious instructions and ChatGPT or Codex may follow them.  The more your assistant reads, the more places an attacker can leave a note for it. Your team lives in Cursor and Claude.

77488.subject: The Quality Trade
77488.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

GM and happy Friday! As crypto equities with real earnings continue to outperform a lagging Bitcoin, a YTD factor analysis delivers proof for the same conclusion. Across the board, capital has moved up the quality curve with the highest-earning, larger-cap assets delivering outperformance over smaller, expensive, and non-earning assets.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

BTC is the laggard again at -1.3% on the week against 2.9% for gold, 2.2% for the NASDAQ 100, and 1.2% for the S&P 500; over a month it is -2.3% while gold has run 8.6%.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8a2ad093-5144-4aab-944e-b0c215c543c9/image.png?t=1786713627)
Caption: 

The market can only absorb bitcoin's biggest bull becoming its biggest seller for so long. Strategy has now sold 6,948 BTC across four disclosures since late May, including 1,690 BTC for $108.6M in the latest sale. Every tranche was sold below its $75,385 average cost, with the proceeds recycled into buybacks of its own preferred shares rather than BTC. 

That selling creates a persistent supply overhang, and BTC’s price action reflects it. BTC traded at $62,829 Friday morning, below every major daily moving average and just above the early August low of $62,662, with the June low near $57,000 marking the next key support level.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/fab09f48-7771-42ca-abe1-341e3bb9e726/image.png?t=1786713627)
Caption: 

Thursday's session belonged to the 2025 crypto equity cohort at 3.0%, ahead of Perps 2.5%, Modular 2.3%, and DeFi 2.2%. Crypto miners were the outlier in the other direction at -7.4%, Hut 8 down 10.3% and Cipher, Core Scientific, and TeraWulf all off 5% or more.

The divergence is starker the further out you go. The 2025 cohort is 10.1% on the week and 12.1% on the month, one of only four indices green over the month, against Modular -23.6%, DePIN -16.1%, DeFi -12.6%, and Perps -12.1%. DEXs were the worst of the week at -11.9% as UNI gave back 13.3%, a full unwind of the fee-switch trade two weeks after Proposal 100 activated it.

Inside the cohort, Bullish led at 15.3% on the week and Circle, at 54.4% of the index, added 10.8%; Figure was up 7.3% while Galaxy lagged at 1.7%.
